text: Margaret Atwood's The Handmaid's Tale: The Graphic Novel was removed from the library collection by the Medford School District, according to a report dated June 29, 2022. Superintendent Bret Champion and his deputy made the decision. The district said it removed the graphic novel because it found numerous images of nudity, sexual assault and violence.
